info.title: Planet Money Podcast Universal API
info.description: Read the public Planet Money podcast feed, archive pages, episode pages, transcripts, and embed pages.

get.description: Retrieves NPR's About Planet Money page.

parameters.name: connectionId
parameters.description: The MindCloud connection ID for this app.

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated response fields to include.

data.description: Raw HTML returned by the public Planet Money about page as a Buffer-shaped object.

401.description: The MindCloud API key is missing or invalid.
